chapter_note: This introductory unit begins with a compact cosmogonic survey (eternal separation, assault of Darkness, First Man, Living Spirit’s construction, Third Ambassador, final fire and binding) in an impersonal, cosmological voice—likely preserving the oldest teaching substrate. After this, the register pivots sharply into self-authorization (Mani’s books), institutional/audience address, and comparative-apostolic polemic (Jesus/Zarathustra/Buddha), with strong late pastoral/application drift and a detected editorial extension.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmogonic-cosmological exposition (separation of principles; aeons; heights) with no audience exhortation, institutional terms, or citation formulas; matches impersonal core survey style despite lacunae.
Binary-principle cosmology (Darkness vs Light) stated as ontological geography; no editorial anchoring to contemporary institutions.

paragraphs.removed_material: Removed introductory editorial/application framing that points to ‘what I have written for you’ and addresses ‘to you’ about ‘the first … concerning the eternality’; retained only the cosmogonic event-description (Darkness’ assault).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Clear seam from meta-discourse about writing/teaching (‘written for you’) into a compact mythic event statement (attack of Darkness). The latter stays cosmos→cosmos and fits the old cosmogonic narrative.

Mythic-cosmological sequence (emanation/descent of First Man; armour of Light) without institutional application. ‘Crucified’ reads as Manichaean mythic metaphor here (no Gospel citation/NT narrative cues).
System-building cosmology (construction of universe; ordering of cosmic structures; light/dark mechanics) in impersonal expository voice—typical substrate material.
Architectonic cosmology with numbered/structured geography (three earths; four mountains; three vessels) and binding function—strong core teaching signature.
Named cosmic redeemer in functional role (purification/redemption) stated without Gospel/NT linkage; consistent with core cosmological hierarchy.

Eschatological cosmology (cosmic fire; ascent of Light; binding of Darkness; final reign) remains within the cosmic system; the second-person ‘You find’ reads as generic conclusion rather than institutional exhortation.
Brief doctrinal statement on primordial mixture/joining—core cosmological premise; no institutional or citation markers.

Canonical self-referential claim listing Mani’s named books (‘Great Gospel’, ‘Treasury’, etc.) functions as justificatory apparatus for scripture/authority, not impersonal cosmology (Gardner flag: canonical_source).
Authorial validation of ‘writer/teacher of truth’ and ‘I … have revealed’ is legitimating rhetoric (meta-discourse about authority), characteristic of later framing rather than substrate instruction.

paragraphs.removed_material: Removed autobiographical/suffering application (‘and my pains… For also … and my afflictions …’) and subsequent evaluative address; retained the structured ‘first great lesson’ schematic with numbered/spatial correspondential elements (twelve/doors/four corners).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying numbered/spatial schematic (‘twelve’, ‘doors’, ‘four corners’) suggests an older correspondential lesson structure, but the paragraph is contaminated by autobiographical ‘my pains/afflictions’ and didactic evaluation, indicating later overlaying voice.

Seam-flagged institutional extension: disciples commanded to write; explicit community categories (‘teachers’, ‘leaders’, ‘elect’, ‘catechumens’, ‘free men/women’) and retrospective collection of homilies—editorial church-operational material.
Pure imperative/application voice (‘You must remember… write… gather…’) with no cosmological mechanism—pastoral exhortation.
Community-tier instruction and institutional categories (‘elect’, ‘suckling babes’) plus rhetorical self-reporting; not cosmos→cosmos mapping, but pastoral/adaptive teaching claims.
Ecclesial and apostolic discourse (‘apostles’, ‘fathers’, ‘church’) with application markers (‘Concerning this…’) and mission geography—late institutional reflection rather than core cosmology.
Explicit Jesus-historical narrative (west; disciples writing parables, signs, wonders) enters via Christian tradition/NT-world biography—classified as Christian overlay.
Hagiographic-comparative prophet material (‘apostle of light… Persia… Hystaspes… Zarathustra… they read today’) used to justify writing/authority; not impersonal cosmological teaching.
Comparative-apostolic narrative about Buddha and his churches/scriptures serves the same canonical justification theme; late framing rhetoric.
Polemic about institutional decay/adulteration when teachings aren’t written; focuses on ‘church’ persistence and leadership failure—pastoral-institutional argumentation.
Commands/commandments + exhortation to write after the speaker ‘so that it leads you not astray’—application voice and community safeguarding, not core cosmology.
Direct audience address and imperative (‘remember! And write…’) about recording oral wisdom—late pastoral instruction justifying the compilation.
Concluding encouragement about benefits of writing; practical exhortation, not cosmological exposition.
